putoḷi.p: [ yādicchakanāma ] (thī) CL=10 (1) bag. (2) A small door.

R:
puṭoḷi：ပုဋောဠိ （ဣ）
အိတ်။
DOP: putoḷī̆ patoḷi paṭṭoli f. [?], a bag or sack; D II 293, 18 (ubhatomukhā ~i pūrā nānāvihitassa dhaññassa … tam enaṃ cakkhumā puriso muñcitvā paccavekkheyya …, Be so; Ce puṭoḷī; Ee mutoli; Se mūtoḷī; Sv 769, 22 : ~i viya, Be so; Ce mūtolī; Ee puṭoḷi; Se putoḷī; Sv-pṭ II 388, 9 : vatthādīhi pasibbakākārena bandhitvā kataṃ āvāpakaṃ mutoḷi, Ee so; Be āvāṭanaṃ ~i) = M I 57, 21 ( Be so; Ce, Se mūtoḷī; Ee mutoḷī) = III 90, 19 ( Be so; Ce, Ee mūtoḷī; Se mūtolī); Sv 769, 25 (taṃ ~iṃ muñcitvā, Be, Se so; Ce mūtoliṃ; Ee puṭoḷiṃ) = Ps I 271, 5 ( Be so; Ce, Se mūtoḷiṃ; Ee mutoḷiṃ); Th-a III 159, 19 (na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatamukhaṃ chupe … ti āha, tattha bhastan ti ruttiṃ, ubhatomukhan ti ~iyā ubhatomukhaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce mūtoḷiyā; Ee mutoḷiyā); Vism-mhṭ [ Be ] I 396, 14 (~iyā khuddakadvārassa mukhaṃ putoḷimukhaṃ; Ce, Se patoḷiyā … patoḷimukhaṃ; ad Vism 328, 13 : yathā nāma yānapputoḷikumbhimukhādīnaṃ aññataraṃ nīlapilotikāya … bandhitvā, Be so; Ce, Se -ppatoḷi-; Ee -paṭṭoli-).

puṭosa.p: [ puṭa + asa. A-kiu o-pru ] (na) CL=10 The food-requisite that is eaten after carried-taken out with a package.

DOP: puṭa ( and pūṭa), m.n. [ S. puṭa], 1. a container, a funnel, often made of leaves, to carry food etc (especially on a journey); a packet; a basket, a bag; S I 175, 8 (phāṇitassa ca ~aṃ āyasmato Upavānassa pādāsi; Spk I 259, 23 : mahantaṃ nicchārikaṃ guḷapiṇḍaṃ); V 439, 12 (padumapattānaṃ vā … māluvapattānaṃ vā ~aṃ karitvā udakaṃ vā tālapattaṃ vā āharissāmī ti); Ja II 391, 5 (mahantamahantāni pattāni gahetvā ayaṃ pupphānaṃ bhavissati ayaṃ phalānan ti ~e katvā; Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pūṭe); V 441, 30 (paṇṇāni āharāpetvā dve ~e katvā ekasmiṃ pāyāsaṃ pakkhipitvā ekasmiṃ cūḷāmaṇiṃ ṭhapetvā bandhitvā); Ud-a 422, 18 (idh’ eva ~aṃ bhindissantī ti); — ifc see assa- ( sv assa 5 ), ucchu-, paṇṇa-, patta- ( sv patta 2 ), palāsa- ( sv palāsa 1 ), bhasma-, ( sv bhasma[n] ); — 2. a cavity; a hollow space; a slit; Spk II 322, 13 (bubbuḷo udakatalaṃ … saṅkaḍḍhitvā ~aṃ katvā gahaṇavātaṃ cā ti … paṭicca uppajjati) = Vibh-a 34, 1 ; — ifc see eka-, kaṇṇa-, karaṇḍa-, nāsā-, sippi-, hattha-; — 3. an ants’ (leaf) nest; Spk II 394, 18 foll. (rājā … tambakipillikānaṃ ~aṃ disvā hatthen’ ākaḍḍhitvā sākhaṃ gaṇhituṃ nāsakkhi, kipillikapuṭo chijjitvā rañño sīse pati, Be so; Ce chinditvā; Ee kipillikapuṭaṃ chijjitvā; Se kipillikānaṃ ~o chinditvā); Pj II 515, 8 (tambakipillikapuṭaṃ gaṇhanto … aññaṃ ~aṃ gahetvā); — ifc see kipillaka-; — °’- aṃsa , mf ( n ). [puṭa + aṃsa 2 ], carrying a food-container over one’s shoulder; Sv 288, 22 (puṭo aṃse assā ti ~o, tena ~ena, aṃsena hi pātheyyapuṭaṃ vahantenāpī ti vuttaṃ hoti; ad D I 117, 20 : upasaṅkamituṃ api ~enā pi, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se puṭosenā pi) = Ps IV 139, 12 foll. = Mp III 168, 19 foll.; — see puṭosa below; — °’- ākārena in Ee at Ap-a 431, 10 is prob. wr for pulākārena ( Be, Se so ); — °’- osa , n. [puṭa + *osa, cf S. avasa], provisions for a journey; D I 117, 20 (alam eva saddhena kulaputtena dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ api ~enāpi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee puṭaṃsenā ti; Sv 288, 20 foll.: ~aṃ vuccati pātheyyaṃ, pātheyyaṃ gahetvā pi upasaṅkamituṃ yuttam evā ti attho, puṭaṃsenā ti pi pāṭho, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee puṭaṃsaṃ vuccati pātheyyaṃ, prob. wr ) = 133, 30 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee puṭaṃsenā ti) ≠ M III 80, 19 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pūṭaṃsenāpi) = A II 183, 34 ( Be so; Ce, Ee, Se puṭaṃsenāpi); — °- pāka , n. [ ts ], something (perhaps herbs) cooked in a leaf-container; Vism 500, 10 (usmanā ~aṃ viya paccamāno) = Paṭis-a 143, 25 ; — °- baddha , °-bandha, mfn. , formed like a container (of leaves); wrapped round; wrapped in a container (of leaves); Vin I 186, 10 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū … ~ā upāhanāyo dhārenti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-vaddhā; Sp 1084, 7 : ~ā ti Yonaka-upāhanā vuccati yā yāva jaṅghato sabbapādaṃ paṭicchādeti, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se pūṭabaddhā ti); Vism 251, 27 (piṭṭhipādattaco ~-upāhanasaṇṭhāno, Ce so; Be, Ee °-bandha-; Se pūṭabandhana-) = Vibh-a 234, 24 ( Ee so; Be, Ce, Se puṭabandha-); Sp 1106, 13 (udakaṃ na paggharati ghanattā ~aṃ viya tiṭṭhati); It-a II 62, 35 (yo puriso upanayhati °-bandhavasena bandhati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pūṭabandha-); Vv-a 308, 10 (pilotikāya ~aṃ kummāsaṃ gahetvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~-kummāsaṃ); Mhv 29:27 (sāṭakāni … ~āni); — °- bhatta , n. , packed food, food for a journey; Ja II 423, 24 ; Th-a II 260, 18 (sambalaṃ nāma ~aṃ); Mhv 36:93; — °- bheda , m. , splitting apart; Vv-a 344, 17 (sipāṭikā … phalatī ti paccitvā vaṇṭato muccati ~aṃ vā patvā sissati); — °- bhedana , n. and mfn. , (being) a market town (with a customs house ?); Abh 198 (puraṃ nagaraṃ … ~aṃ); Vin I 229, 10 (idaṃ agganagaraṃ bhavissati Pāṭaliputtaṃ ~aṃ) = D II 87, 34 = Ud 88, 27 ( Be, Ce so; Ee, Se omit Pāṭaliputtaṃ; Se pūṭabhedanaṃ); Sv 541, 6 (bhaṇḍapuṭabhedanaṭṭhānaṃ, bhaṇḍabhaṇḍikānaṃ mocanaṭṭhānan ti; Sv-pṭ II 178, 18 : bhaṇḍapuṭe bhindanti mocenti etthā ti ~an ti) = Sp 1096, 4 ( so read in Ee, Se for bhaṇḍagaṇḍikānaṃ; Be ~an ti ~-ṭṭhānaṃ, mocanaṭṭhānan ti vuttaṃ hoti; missing in Ce ) = Ud-a 422, 14 ; Mil 1, 13 (atthi Yonakānaṃ nānāpuṭabhedanaṃ Sāgalaṃ nāma nagaraṃ); — °- vedikā , f. , a railing surrounding a cetiya; Sv 650, 17 (chattavedikā ~ā kucchivedikā, Be, Ee so; Ce muddavedikā; Se muddhivedikā; Sv-pṭ II 280, 11 : cetiyaṃ parikkhipitvā padakkhiṇakaraṇaṭṭhānaṃ antokatvā kātabbā vedikā ~ā); — see also kacchapuṭa.
